daysBack.title: Lookback days
daysBack.description: How far back to look for business-registry and permit signals.

daysAhead.title: Future business-start horizon
daysAhead.description: Include City business records with a registered location start date this many days into the future.

verticals.title: Business verticals
verticals.description: Optional vertical filter. Leave empty for all commercial opportunities.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional text match against business name, industry, permit type and work description.

minScore.title: Minimum opportunity score
minScore.description: 0-100. Higher values return fewer but stronger signals.

onlyMultiSignal.title: Only independently confirmed opportunities
onlyMultiSignal.description: Require both a City business-registry signal and a building-permit signal at the same normalized address.

includeBusinessRegistrations.title: Use business registry/start dates
includeBusinessRegistrations.description: Include active City business-registry records and their registered location start dates.

includeSubmittedPermits.title: Use submitted permits
includeSubmittedPermits.description: Include recently submitted City building-permit applications as early project signals.

includeIssuedPermits.title: Use issued permits
includeIssuedPermits.description: Include recently issued City building permits as project-progress signals.

includeResidential.title: Include residential permit signals
includeResidential.description: Include permits classified as residential. Off by default because this Actor is designed for B2B prospecting.

maxResults.title: Maximum opportunities
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ranked opportunities to write to the default dataset.

maxRecordsPerSource.title: Maximum source records
maxRecordsPerSource.description: Safety cap per City dataset before scoring and merging.

includeRaw.title: Include raw source rows
includeRaw.description: Add the original public-data row under each evidence item. Usually not needed and increases output size.
